Recipe: Jollof Rice

    Region: West African

    Ingredients:
    rice, tomatoes, onions, pepper, chicken stock

    Estimated Cost:
    $12

    Instructions:
    Cook tomato sauce. Add rice and simmer.

Recipe: Chicken Fried Rice

    Region: East Asian

    Ingredients:
    rice, chicken, soy sauce, garlic, egg

    Estimated Cost:
    $13

    Instructions:
    Cook chicken. Stir fry rice and egg.
